resolution.note: lane run accepts a Refs-only commit and ships it with a Refs body

title: krn lane run ships a commit with a Refs trailer for a task that stays open
body:
Why: lane standards-pack (t-8vk9p13, $2.65 opus) committed PR 1 of a two-PR task with 'Refs: t-8vk9p13' as the task's lead note and KRN-11 require while the task stays open; lane run then stopped exit 74 'no commit with a Ticket: t-8vk9p13 trailer' and the lead shipped by hand.
Outcome: krn lane run accepts a Refs: <task> trailer as the lane's commit (the PR body uses --refs, the task stays open), and still refuses a commit naming neither trailer.
Proof: lane-run test with a Refs-only commit ships; one with no trailer still exits 74.
